profile.headline: Software Engineer | Process Optimization | Automation
profile.summary:
Software Engineer specializing in internal platforms, workflow automation, and enterprise operational systems.

Throughout my career, I've been drawn to one type of problem: when a process is slow, repetitive, or error-prone, there's usually a better system waiting to be built.

I began my engineering career in fintech, where I developed enterprise software, built automated testing frameworks, and contributed to high-compliance financial systems. Later, I pivoted that same engineering mindset into core business operations—designing internal applications, building automation pipelines, and replacing manual workflows with scalable software solutions. From asset-tracking platforms and payroll automation to scheduled reporting systems, my work consistently focuses on reducing operational friction.

Core Technical Stack:
Languages: Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL
Frontend/Backend: React, Node.js, REST APIs, Office Scripts
Domains: Workflow Automation, Internal Tooling, Cloud Process Orchestration, System Auditing

I enjoy collaborating across engineering, product, and business operations to translate chaotic workflows into scalable, reliable software. I'm always looking for opportunities to build products that help teams move faster and operate at scale. 

Girls in tech, slay in tech 💅

positions.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Office Administrator)
positions.description:
Technical solutions lead within the administrative team, leveraging full-stack software development principles to engineer internal tooling, automate data validation pipelines, and optimize operational productivity.

Process Optimization & Automation: Engineered a comprehensive Time Entry Audit system using Microsoft Power Automate, transforming a manual, labor-intensive review process into a streamlined, high-accuracy digital workflow that ensured strict operational compliance.

Asset Management & Technical Oversight: Structured and managed a high-volume hardware inventory system by developing a customized Device Tracker via Office Scripts, eliminating tracking discrepancies and optimizing device availability for daily venue operations.

Data Integrity & Financial Administration: Audited and reconciled complex administrative data, leveraging advanced Excel automation to eliminate human error, expedite multi-departmental reporting, and secure confidentiality across all employee rosters and venue logs.

Cross-Functional Operations: Served as a key operational anchor for venue management, balancing traditional office administration—such as supply replenishment and financial records processing—with modern technical solutions to boost total office efficiency.

projects.title: Foodbae
projects.description:
Built a full stack web application using Java Spring Boot and React that displays 
597 San Francisco food trucks sourced from the City of SF's open dataset. 

Features include real-time weather at each truck's location via the Open Meteo API, 
search, sorting, and full CRUD functionality through a RESTful backend API.

Built with: Java 21 · Spring Boot 4.1.0 · Spring Data JPA · H2 Database · 
React 19 · Vite · Axios · React Router · Railway · Vercel

Architecture: MVC pattern with a service layer, repository pattern for data access, 
and OOP principles including encapsulation and abstraction throughout the backend.
